events.verdict: Allen (PHX) moves laterally and extends his arms into Sexton's (CHI) path, initiating body contact that affects Sexton's SQBR during the drive.
Booker (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball to block Sexton's (CHI) driving shot attempt. The ensuing follow-through arm contact after the block is considered incidental.
Okoro (CHI) does not establish himself in a legal guarding position prior to contact occurring with Coffey (PHX) during the play at the basket.
Green (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Jones' (CHI) path as he defends the drive and shot attempt.
Sexton (CHI ) brings his left hand toward the ball brushes Green's (PHX) leg during the driving shot attempt, and the contact is marginal.

Green (PHX) makes contact with the ball as he attempts to dislodge the rebound away from Richards (CHI). After his hand slides off the ball, the follow-through contact with Richards' shoulder and arm is marginal.
Sexton (CHI) grasps and immediately releases Coffey's (PHX) arm during the drive, and the contact is marginal.
Ighodaro (PHX) is already in Jones' (CHI) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Sexton (CHI) contests Coffey's (PHX) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
Okoro (CHI) establishes himself in Green's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Coffey (PHX) moves laterally into Jones' (CHI) path and initiates body contact that affects Jones' SQBR during the drive.
Ighodaro (PHX) establishes himself in Okoro's (CHI) path prior to the contact.
Okoro (CHI) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Richards (CHI) and Ighodaro (PHX) come together as they move toward the basket for a potential rebound, and the contact is incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Okoro's (CHI) foot comes down out of bounds before he releases the pass. Possession is correctly awarded to Phoenix.
Ighodaro (PHX) establishes himself in Okoro's (CHI) path prior to the contact.
Ighodaro (PHX) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.

After the release, Green's left arm inadvertently contacts Yabusele's face and the contact is marginal.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Yabusele (CHI) contests Green's (PHX) shot attempt, and the contact after the release is marginal.
Coffey (PHX) commits a take foul on Richards (CHI).
Okoro (CHI) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect the rebound away from Dunn (PHX). The ensuing follow-through contact after the ball is deflected away is considered incidental.
